title: Reversible color changing response of pyrenylated charge-transfer probes towards Hg2+: linker-driven modulation of sensitivity and selectivity
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,9587-9593
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08302D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nilanjan Dey
Two easily synthesizable prenylated charge-transfer probes with a terminal pyridine unit were developed for selective Hg2+detection, with one probe exhibiting enhanced sensitivity and lower detection limits, as demonstrated in paper-based sensors.
